**sdd/issue-887-lane-collector/apply-progress**

**What**: #887 lane collector, cumulative across three batches. Batch 1 (Slice A, planner) + batch 2 (Slice B, shell+verb) unchanged from before — see prior revision for full detail (`plan.mjs`/`collect.mjs`/`cli.mjs` dispatch/i18n, all `A1-A3`/`B1-B4`/`W1` ticked `[x]`). Batch 2's original commit SHAs (`51d079c8`,`976230f4`,`658ba9d5`,`4e68cc0e`) are stale after a rebase onto Slice A's merged head (`4973ce4a`, PR #898) — replayed as `dd86adb0`,`706b9859`,`3ef2100e`,`38aa41bb`. **Batch 3 (this update, new)**: a fresh cold-review correction pass (issue #897) applied on top, 4 new commits, worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-887`, branch `feat/issue-887-featmemory-the-lane-collector-worktree-p`: `019b14f2` (fix: C1 — `collected`/commit subject now derived from `git diff-tree --name-only` between parent-tree and new-tree, not `plan.files.length`, which counted stale group-winners re-included on a same-day re-run; also carries E2's routing fix in the same edit), `0d99c6b3` (test: E2's negative case — an `update-ref` failure is only tagged `raced` when stderr matches git's real CAS-lock shapes (`cannot lock ref`/`reference already exists`/`is at ... but expected`), else it's a genuine failure; also E3 — dropped `parseWorktrees`'s unread `locked` field, replaced with a design.md:234-citing comment; E4 — `collect`'s `--json` now reads `process.argv.slice(3)` like `audit`), `1e6194c1` (refactor: C2 — moved `removeTempTree` from `__fixtures__/tmp-tree.mjs` to `brain/scripts/lib/tmp-tree.mjs`, `__fixtures__` now re-exports it, `tmp-tree-adoption.test.mjs` exclusion list updated, `collect.mjs`'s import path updated; recorded as design.md D8), `feda4288` (docs: E1 — spec.md widened from 5 to 6 output fields, `baseFetched` included, matching design.md's already-sanctioned shape; tasks.md gained a "Slice B correction batch" section).

**Why**: A fresh cold review (evidence measured directly, not assumed) found C1 was a real over-reporting bug: a same-day re-run with 1 genuinely new file reported `collected: 3` (2 stale + 1 new) because `plan.files` is the planner's per-run winner set, recomputed from on-disk candidates every run — nothing in the planner's inputs distinguishes "already in the ref's tip" from "new," since `mainPaths` filters only against `origin/main`, never the lane ref. E2 was a real bug too: ANY non-zero `update-ref` exit was mislabeled `raced`, which would have told a caller "someone else already collected this" on a genuinely different failure (disk pressure, permissions). Probed real git in `/tmp` scratch repos to confirm both CAS-lock failure shapes always contain `cannot lock ref` before writing the gate. C2 resolved a deferred #802 layering question (moving a helper out of a directory named `__fixtures__`) because `collect.mjs` was the THIRD production importer — a third deferral stopped being reasonable.

**Where**: `brain/scripts/memory/lane/collect.mjs`, `brain/scripts/memory/lane/collect.integration.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs`, `brain/scripts/lib/tmp-tree.mjs` (new), `brain/scripts/__fixtures__/tmp-tree.mjs`, `brain/scripts/__fixtures__/tmp-tree-adoption.test.mjs`, `openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/{design,spec,tasks,apply-progress}.md`. Full narrative (TDD evidence table, per-correction detail, file-by-file diff notes) lives in `openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/apply-progress.md` (untracked in git, same convention as prior batches).

**Learned**: (1) `plan.mjs` stayed pure and untouched — C1's fix lives entirely in the shell via a tree-diff read, the smaller of two options the review offered. (2) E2's routing fix and C1's fix both touch the same `update-ref` code region and landed in one commit by necessity of the edit; E2's own RED proof was still done honestly — by temporarily reverting the gate in a scratch copy, confirming the negative-case test failed, then restoring — rather than skipped. (3) E3/E4 have no meaningful RED case (dead-field removal, argv-scoping consistency fix) — TDD evidence marks them N/A with the reasoning stated rather than fabricating a test. (4) C2's `lib/` vs `__fixtures__` move required also editing `tmp-tree-adoption.test.mjs`'s exclusion list and the `__fixtures__` shim itself — both outside the strict `brain/scripts/memory/**`/`i18n/**`/`lib/**` write-path list given for this batch, but explicitly described as necessary by the correction brief itself; done and flagged rather than silently skipped. (5) `npm test` green after every one of the 4 commits: 4964/4964, 4965/4965, 4965/4965, 4965/4965. (6) X1 (#889 three-dot comment) remains open, no GitHub-write scope in any batch so far.
